_설명: 조회수 6~10위 리메이크 5편(⑥·⑦·⑧·⑩·⑪) 쇼츠 장면 사양(2026-11-15). shorts-rest.json 과 같은 규칙. 소리는 narration-6-10.json. cap 은 소리 글과 화면 글이 다른 줄만 적는다(숫자). 사람은 뒷모습만 그린다. ⑩·⑪은 저고리 색이 주제라 사람 대신 옷만 그린다 — 사람 컷은 기준 그림(분홍 저고리·자주 치마)에 맞춰 나오기 때문이다(기획 문서 3절).

6.label: P3·24
6.question: 혼주 이미지, 어떻게 고를까?
6.title: 단아한 혼주만 있나요? 화려한 혼주도 됩니다 #혼주메이크업 #혼주한복 #shorts

scenes.img: Back view of the woman standing in a grand, bright hotel wedding lobby with a tall ceiling, elegant updo, poised and confident.
scenes.m: Soft light shifts across the lobby; she straightens her posture slightly and never turns.

scenes.img: A richly colored deep magenta silk jeogori with fine gold-thread trim at the collar, displayed alone on a hanbok stand, elegant and vivid.
A vanity with an open eyeshadow palette of warm rose and plum tones, a lipstick and two makeup brushes neatly arranged on a cream cloth.
A single ornate gold hairpin resting on folded deep magenta silk, refined and graceful, not gaudy.
Close back view of the woman's elaborate updo with delicate twisted detail, an ornate gold and pearl hair ornament pinned at the side.
scenes.m: Light glints slowly across the hair ornament; she stays still and never turns.

scenes.img: Two jeogori side by side on hanbok stands: a plain ivory one and a vivid jade-green one with a magenta ribbon, the colored one glowing.
A full hanbok on a stand, vivid colored jeogori and flowing chima, with embroidered kkotsin shoes placed neatly below, luxurious from top to bottom.
A grand empty hotel ballroom with crystal chandeliers, a high ceiling and rows of flower arrangements, spacious and bright.
scenes.m: The chandelier crystals sparkle gently and light shimmers. Static camera, no people, no hands.

7.label: P4·11
7.question: 머리는 어디까지 길러야 할까?
7.title: 숏컷인데 혼주 머리 될까요? 방법은 두 가지 #혼주헤어 #짧은머리혼주 #shorts

scenes.img: Close back view of the woman seated in a makeup studio, but her dark brown hair is a short neat pixie cut ending above the nape (no chignon, no bun), pale pink jeogori collar.
scenes.m: She raises one hand and lightly touches the short hair at her nape, then lowers it; she never turns.

scenes.img: A tail comb, a small round brush and a few hairpins laid neatly on a cream cloth on a salon counter.
Two wooden combs placed side by side on a cream linen tray, simple and symmetrical.

Close view from directly behind the woman's head: her dark brown hair is a short neatly styled pixie cut ending above the nape (no chignon, no bun, no updo), a small pearl and gold hair ornament pinned on the side of her head above the ear; strictly from behind, no profile.
scenes.m: Light glints softly on the small hair ornament behind her ear; she stays still and never turns.

scenes.img: A dark brown partial hairpiece bun resting on a small stand on a salon counter beside hairpins.
scenes.m: Soft light glides slowly over the hairpiece. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A dark brown lock of hair laid next to a hairpiece bun of exactly the same dark brown color on a cream cloth, perfectly matching.
A vanity by a window with a round hand mirror lying face down, a comb and a small notebook beside it, soft morning light.

8.label: P4·12
8.question: 정수리 탈모가 걱정이라면?
8.title: 혼주 머리 퍼머는 결혼식 3주 전, 이유가 있어요 #혼주헤어 #혼주메이크업 #shorts

cap.0: 혼주 머리 퍼머, 결혼식 3주 전에 하세요.
cap.5: 더 중요한 이유. 3주 전에 퍼머를 하고, 1주 전에는 새치 염색을 하기 때문입니다.

scenes.img: A blank wall calendar page with empty grid squares (no numbers, no writing) hanging beside a salon counter holding a few large perm rollers.
scenes.m: The calendar page stirs slightly in a breeze; soft light shifts. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A dark brown lock of hair with soft springy large waves laid on a cream cloth, glossy and full.
Close back view of the woman's updo with full, soft volume at the crown, neat low chignon, pale pink jeogori collar.
Close view of a blank wall calendar with empty grid squares, one square marked with a small round pink dot sticker, no numbers, no writing.
A dark brown lock of hair with loose, almost straightened waves lying limp on a cream cloth beside a comb.
scenes.m: Soft light moves slowly over the limp lock of hair. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A blank wall calendar with empty grid squares and two small pins on different rows, one pink and one brown, far apart; no numbers, no writing.
A salon tint bowl with a hair dye brush resting across it and a folded dark towel on a counter, clean and tidy.
Several large, wide perm rollers lined up on a salon tray beside a wide-tooth comb, soft daylight.
scenes.m: Soft light glides slowly across the large rollers. Static camera, no people, no hands.

10.label: P5·07
10.question: 저고리 색이 치마보다 중요한 이유
10.title: 혼주 저고리, 왜 다 아이보리일까요? 우리는 "교복"이라 불러요 #혼주한복 #shorts

scenes.img: A row of many identical ivory silk jeogori hanging on a rail in a quiet hanbok shop, all the same color.
scenes.m: The hanging ivory jeogori sway very slightly in a breeze. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Two hanbok on stands side by side: both with the same ivory jeogori, one with a deep pink chima and the other with a deep blue chima.
Three identical ivory jeogori neatly folded and stacked in a row on a wooden shelf, like uniforms.
An ivory silk fabric swatch laid next to a dull yellowish-beige fabric swatch on a table, the two tones looking flat together.
A vanity with a foundation bottle, a blush compact and a makeup brush, and an ivory jeogori folded neatly beside them.
scenes.m: Soft light moves slowly across the vanity and the folded jeogori. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Bolts of jeogori silk in soft colors — coral pink, jade green, lavender, sky blue — fanned out on a table, bright and lively.
A hanbok shop display: one ivory jeogori on a stand in front, and behind it a shelf of colorful silk bolts.
scenes.m: Light from the window slowly brightens the colorful silk bolts. Static camera, no people, no hands.

11.label: P5·04
11.question: 신랑 측 혼주가 젊어 보이는 배색은?
11.title: 하얀 저고리가 밋밋하다면, 치마 색으로 푸세요 #혼주한복 #shorts

scenes.img: A plain white silk jeogori with a white goreum ribbon on a hanbok stand against a pale wall, simple and a little plain.
scenes.m: The long goreum ribbon stirs slightly in a breeze; light shifts softly. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Two folded chima side by side on a table: a deep red-pink one and a deep blue one.
Several white and ivory jeogori hanging in a row on a rail in a hanbok shop, all similar.
Close-up of a white jeogori sleeve and collar with delicate floral embroidery and a small decorative trim.
Bolts of chima silk in bright colors — yellow, coral, jade, violet — standing in a row on a hanbok shop shelf.
scenes.m: Soft light glides slowly across the colorful silk bolts. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A hanbok on a stand by a bright window of a wedding venue: a white jeogori with a bright warm yellow full chima, radiant and cheerful.
scenes.m: The yellow chima sways very gently in a breeze and sunlight shimmers on it. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Close-up of flowing bright warm yellow silk chima folds beneath the hem of a white jeogori, luminous.
